makers.headline: Founder of Chalked — the reply layer

makers.name: Ben Clarke
makers.headline: Founder of A2A Net and Lifey

Creators can discover brand opportunities and get paid for their content, regardless of audience size. From discovery and campaign management to automation, tracking, and integrations, Scrub brings the entire creator marketing workflow into one place.

posts.name: Trailmarks iOS
posts.tagline: Real World Travel Quiz & Trivia Adventure
posts.description: Trailmarks is a travel trivia game built on the real world. You answer true-or-false questions about the city you're in, then spend the rewards on a ticket out, limited by what the departure board offers and what you can afford. Your score is the kilometers behind you. The routes are real: flights that exist, trains where there are tracks, boats across oceans. 1000+ cities. iPhone only, $4.99 once, no ads, no account, plays fully offline.

posts.name: ALIA
posts.tagline: The data infrastructure for AI that speaks Africa

posts.name: Present: Clock + Weather + Calendar
posts.tagline: Everything you need at a glance. Nothing else.
posts.description: Every other app wants your attention. Present just wants to give it back. No feeds. No notifications begging you to stay. Just the time, the date, the weather, and what's next — in a single glance. Because your hands aren't always free. You're getting ready for work, cooking dinner, halfway under the car in the garage. A quick look across the room shouldn't cost you ten minutes of scrolling. Present keeps you on track without pulling you in. Glance, know, and get back to your life.

posts.tagline: The harness interoperability layer for coding agents
